newsitem.title: COTE D'IVOIRE: Rwanda appoints IACO coffee economist as minister.
newsitem.headline: Rwanda appoints IACO coffee economist as minister.

text.p: Rwanda has appointed Interafrican Coffee Organisation (IACO) chief economist Donald Kaberuka as Minister of State for Finance and Economic Planning, an IACO spokesman said on Tuesday.
"He left on April 30," the spokesman said.
Kaberuka worked for IACO for 13 years before before leaving the Ivory Coast-based organisation for his native Rwanda.
IACO represents African coffee producers' interests at world level.
In December, it pushed the International Coffee Organisation into tightening robusta coffee export quotas to propel world prices closer to those for Arabica coffee.
About 72 percent African coffee production is robusta. The largest producer is Uganda, followed closely by Ivory Coast.
IACO had not yet advertised to fill the position left by Kaberuka but the spokemsan said it would certainly be done. --Matthew Bunce, Abidjan newsroom + 225 21 90 90
